highlights.excerpt:
No crypto wallet is 100% safe.
No software is bug free.
No tech is 100% secure.

There are risks in everything you do.
There are risks if you don't do anything.

There will be issues, setbacks and problems to solve.

Stay up-to-date. Manage risks. Solve problems.
highlights.excerpt_zh:
没有加密钱包是 100% 安全的。
没有软件没有 bug。
没有技术是 100% 安全的。

你做的每件事都有风险。
什么都不做也有风险。

总会有问题、挫折和要解决的麻烦。

保持更新。管理风险。解决问题。
highlights.name: CZ 🔶 BNB
highlights.text_zh: CZ：没有钱包百分百安全，软件都有 bug；接受风险、持续更新、解决问题。

highlights.excerpt:
Starting next week, sessions across Claude web, desktop, and mobile apps will run in auto mode by default on Pro, Max, and Team plans.

Rather than asking you to approve each step, an automated check blocks risky actions. Switch back to manual anytime. https://t.co/g9yvbMWH6X
highlights.excerpt_zh:
从下周起，Claude 网页、桌面和移动端会话将在 Pro、Max 和 Team 方案上默认以自动模式运行。

不再让你逐步审批，而是由自动检查拦截危险操作。可随时切回手动。
highlights.name: Claude
highlights.text_zh: Claude 下起默认开启自动模式（Pro/Max/Team）：不再逐步审批，危险操作由自动检查拦截。

highlights.excerpt:
Vercel now has all the pieces in place to host at-scale backends. 

WebSockets, Queues, Workflows, Cron, Services, Containers, Python, Daemons, Long-duration Functions, Blob, Drives, Sandbox…

Any guesses what comes next? https://t.co/iTBNChcP2Q

Vercel 现在已具备托管大规模后端的全部组件。

WebSockets、队列、工作流、Cron、服务、容器、Python、守护进程、长时函数、Blob、驱动器、沙箱…

猜猜接下来是什么？

highlights.excerpt: A visible sign of what AI insiders have been warning about since at least the Mythos release. Acceleration of attack and defense, at inhuman speeds, interacting with the very human systems that need to react to them. https://t.co/jEI8WDjslo
highlights.excerpt_zh: 这是至少从 Mythos 发布以来，AI 圈内人就在警告的可见迹象。攻防以非人速度加速，却仍与需要对其作出反应的非常人类的系统相互作用。
highlights.name: Ethan Mollick
highlights.text_zh: Mollick：攻防被 AI 加速到非人速度，却仍撞上需要反应的人类系统。

highlights.excerpt: Established companies will at best adapt to AI. Newly founded startups will be AI-native from the start. This is an interesting example of a company in the middle, which (by great effort) remade itself as an AI-native company. https://t.co/JGG0JGf21K
highlights.excerpt_zh: 既有公司最多只能适应 AI。新创立的创业公司从一开始就会是 AI 原生。这是一个有趣的中间例子：一家（付出巨大努力）把自己重塑为 AI 原生公司的企业。
highlights.name: Paul Graham
highlights.text_zh: Paul Graham：老公司最多适应 AI；新创生来即 AI 原生，中间转型者值得关注。
